newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE TO ACT AGAINST ROUGH PLAY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE TO ACT AGAINST ROUGH PLAY.

text.p: French rugby union officials will take steps to stop some of their leading players indulging in rough play.

Players such as centre Richard Dourthe and lock Olivier Merle, already suspended in the past for misbehaving in internationals, were criticised again after a friendly against Wales last week in which they were guilty of a number of violent fouls.
"We did not take any sanctions and the Welsh union did not ask us to. We shall solve the problem internally," French manager Jo Maso told the sports daily l'Equipe.

"We shall be extremely firm with a boy like Richard Dourthe, who has to make amends. The Springboks are coming and the team spirit must be radically different. If it's not, we will make other decisions."
The South Africans tour France in late November and early December.
